name: orb_index_aligned_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: NIFTY's first 15 minutes (09:15–09:30) is the overnight information absorption window where FII hedges, pre-open auction imbalances, and gap-fill orders are digested into a defined price range. When NIFTY closes above that range's high with 3+ consecutive 5-second bars, it signals that buy-side institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms have exhausted all resting supply at the ORB ceiling and are continuing to accumulate — the same institutional flow tailwind the original strategy used an index-alignment filter to detect. VWAP confirmation (close > VWAP) ensures the breakout is aligned with the dominant session bias rather than a counter-trend spike. At 5-second resolution we enter within 15 seconds of breakout confirmation, capturing the first impulse leg before TWAP algos pause for rebalancing.

indicators.name: orb_high
indicators.purpose: Fixed time window 09:15–09:30 = 180 bars at 5s — same 15-minute ORB as original, unchanged because this is a fixed-time-window indicator (the 15-minute opening range exists independent of bar frequency). Not scaled.

indicators.name: orb_low
indicators.purpose: Same reasoning as orb_high — fixed 15-minute ORB window.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(typical_price * volume) / cumsum(volume), reset at session open
indicators.purpose: Cumulative measure from session open — no scaling needed. Used as a trend bias filter: breakout above ORB that is also above VWAP confirms institutional demand absorption from open, not a spike against session trend.

indicators.name: above_orb_count
indicators.formula: consecutive bars with close > orb_high (reset on day boundary)
indicators.purpose: 3-bar persistence (15 seconds) filter replicates the original's '3+ consecutive NIFTY 1-min bars above ORB' confirmation at 5s resolution. Original needed 3 minutes; we need 15 seconds because 5s bars are noisy but 3 consecutive 5s closes above ORB is statistically significant. The SAME bar-count logic, different granularity.

indicators.name: below_orb_count
indicators.formula: consecutive bars with close < orb_low (reset on day boundary)
indicators.purpose: Symmetric to above_orb_count for bearish breakdowns below ORB low.

conditions: above_orb_count == 3 (exactly at 3rd consecutive close above orb_high — fire once per breakout event)
vix in [vix_low, vix_high] (13-22, avoid extreme fear/complacency)
buy_ce.confirmation: 3 consecutive 5-second closes above ORB high — replicates original's 3-bar NIFTY confirmation

conditions: below_orb_count == 3 (exactly at 3rd consecutive close below orb_low)

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option pts = ~8 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5. A genuine ORB breakout should not retrace more than 8 spot pts within 30-60 seconds; if it does the ORB level is not acting as support and the institutional buy flow has reversed — thesis is wrong. Calibrated to 1-minute NIFTY typical range of 3-7 pts (stop sits at the wide end of a single-bar move).
exit.target_rationale: 7 option pts = ~14 spot pts. The first impulse leg of an NIFTY ORB breakout extends 20-35 spot pts beyond the ORB level on confirmed institutional flow days. 14 pts captures ~40-50% of the expected first-leg move at 1:1.75 R:R, consistent with the 2-minute NIFTY typical move range of 5-10 option pts.

filters.vix_filter: India VIX 13–22 (same as original's 13-22 range — high VIX makes ORB levels unreliable as gaps widen beyond the ORB itself; low VIX below 13 indicates no institutional flow driving the breakout)
filters.time_filter: enter only 09:30–15:20; ORB must be fully formed before any entry
filters.volume_filter: none explicit — at 5s on the index, volume is sufficiently liquid; volume threshold from original is stock-specific and doesn't translate to index
filters.trend_filter: VWAP alignment (close > VWAP for CE, close < VWAP for PE) replaces the original's index-alignment filter — we ARE the index now, VWAP is the intra-session trend anchor

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — ORB strategies have become widely known, but the 5-second precision entry (vs 1-min or 3-min confirmation in retail implementations) provides timing edge

adaptation_notes: Original strategy required a UNIVERSE of NIFTY50 stocks AND NIFTY index to both break their respective ORBs simultaneously. In the conversion, we trade NIFTY OPTIONS when NIFTY breaks its own ORB — the index IS the instrument. The 'alignment' concept is preserved through VWAP filtering (confirming session bias). The 3-bar confirmation translates from 3 minutes (3 × 1-min bars) to 15 seconds (3 × 5s bars) — same structural logic, different granularity. Stock-specific elements (beta filter, stock ORB range, stock volume surge) are dropped entirely. Hold time compressed from 30-180 minutes to 30-120 seconds because we're taking the first impulse leg only.
weaknesses: NIFTY ORB breakouts above 09:30 that retrace by 10:30 (false breakouts) will trigger multiple losing trades; the confirm_bars filter reduces but does not eliminate this
On expiry days NIFTY often gaps sharply making the 15-min ORB unusually wide, reducing the number of qualified breakouts
Signal fires only once per breakout event (exact count == confirm_bars); if ORB is re-tested and re-broken after a pullback, a second signal fires — potentially doubling down on a choppy day
